name: c_Classical_medium
prompt: Subject: a town of about seven buildings of cream stone houses with columns and terracotta roofs, a small temple, with a low wall, a classical era city.
style: Style: a very simple chunky low-poly game icon in the style of The Battle of Polytopia. Background: solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF filling the whole canvas edge to edge. The object must not contain any magenta or pink.
